🇬🇧 English: HST.035 covers cellular injury, necrosis, apoptosis, acute and chronic inflammation, wound healing, vascular hemodynamic disorders, atherosclerosis, and neoplasia.

IT Danno Cellulare, Necrosi e Apoptosi
EN Cellular Injury, Necrosis, and Apoptosis

Ipossia, deplezione di ATP, transizione di permeabilità mitocondriale e attivazione delle caspasi.

Hypoxia, ATP depletion, mitochondrial permeability transition, and caspase activation.
